model.description: Default model for new sessions: <provider>/<model>, e.g. anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.

reduceMotion.description: Turn off UI animations (the macOS Reduce Motion setting is honored as well).

autoCompact.description: Automatically compact the built-in agent's context when it nears the context budget (default true). /compact still works when disabled.

closeToTray.description: Closing the window hides TKCode to the system tray and keeps sessions running (default true). When false, closing the window quits TKCode.

originalImages.description: Show Markdown images at full resolution. By default they are decoded at their display size to save memory; clicking an image always opens the original.

providers.description: Keyed by provider id. A built-in id (anthropic, openai, deepseek, openrouter, …) overrides the catalog; any other id defines a custom provider.

webSearch.description: Search backend for the built-in agent's web_search tool. The tool is unavailable until this is configured.

baseUrl.description: Custom endpoint. Required for searxng (the instance URL, with the JSON format enabled).

additionalDirectories.description: Extra directories treated as part of the workspace: read-only tools need no approval inside them.

defaultRole.description: Mode for new conversations: agent (default), plan, acp, or the name of a custom role from roles/*.md. A custom role that the project does not define falls back to agent.

autoDiscover.description: List skills in the built-in agent's system prompt so the model can load them on its own (default true). When false, skills are used only when named with /skill-name.

prerelease.description: Also receive releases marked as pre-release on GitHub (default true). When false, only stable releases are offered.

autoCheck.description: Check 60 seconds after start and every 6 hours after that (default true). When false, check from Settings › About.

mcpServers.description: MCP servers for the built-in agent (and, through the TKCode bridge, external runtimes). Keys are server names: 1-32 letters, digits, '_' or '-'.

mcpServer.description: A command makes it a local (stdio) server; a url makes it a remote server. Strings accept {env:VAR}, ${VAR}, ${VAR:-default}, ${workspaceFolder} and ${userHome}.

type.description: Usually inferred. http = Streamable HTTP (falls back to legacy SSE automatically); sse forces legacy HTTP+SSE.

cwd.description: Working directory. Defaults to the session's project directory.

envFile.description: A dotenv file whose variables are added to env.

headers.description: An Authorization header disables the OAuth login flow.

clientId.description: Pre-registered client id. Omit to use dynamic client registration.

disabledTools.description: Tools (MCP names) hidden from the model.

alwaysAllow.description: Tools that never ask for approval; "*" allows the whole server.

secret.description: Plain value, {env:VAR} or $VAR. Use "" for local servers that need no key.

compat.description: Escape hatch for verified vendor quirks. Usually auto-detected.

model.description: All fields optional; catalog metadata is used when the model is known.

api.description: Wire protocol for this model. Defaults to the provider's protocol.

baseUrl.description: Base URL for this model. Defaults to the provider's base URL.

defaultContextWindow.description: Default context budget for new sessions (the smaller picker option). Default 272000; gpt-6.1-sol 500000.

api.description: Wire protocol: OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses or Anthropic Messages. Required for custom providers.

models.description: When present, only these models are enabled. Use {} to take catalog defaults.
